ruling.recommended_action: Refund $4.33 (Ryde voucher per NS-7) to the rider and record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file; no account flag.
ruling.reasoning: RD-1 is engaged: the trace confirms one off-route segment, F3 (09:24–09:30, 3.78 km driven where the optimal route covers 0.71 km, adding 3.07 km, up to 688 m from the optimal route), against an optimal route of 21.2 km and 24.4 km actually driven [F1][F3][RD-1]. No exemption applies to it. RD-4 fails: F13 records no traffic incident near the route during the trip window, and the only band records (F11, F12, band 5 = 40–49 km/h) are mid-range, not band 1/2, and at most corroborative [F11][F12][F13][RD-4]. RD-5 also fails, on my reading of the chat: the record is complete and fully timestamped [F9], and its only messages are the rider's pickup note at 09:04 [F7] and the driver's car description at 09:05 [F8] — fully two messages, both before 09:24, neither of which agrees to any route change, general or named. The driver's post-trip statement that he "went where the GPS sent me; it rerouted" [F10] is not rider consent (G11) and is in any case contradicted by the measured deviation of 688 m [F3]; it is also not traffic evidence under RD-4 [F10][RD-5]. RD-3 reaches no stop at all: no rider message names any place where the car stopped, so a rider-requested stop cannot exempt the segment [F7][F8][RD-3]. The segment therefore counts, and the ride is metered RydeTAXI, so the detour distance entered the fare directly [F6][RD-2]. Amount: the trip's rate is the fare record's distance fare ÷ distance km = $34.42 ÷ 24.41 km = $1.4101/km; 3.07 km × $1.4101/km = $4.3300 → $4.33 [F3][F4][F6][RD-2]. The remainder of the +3.2 km total excess [F1] is not refunded: RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment's extra_km, and the corridor/noise metres never entered a segment [F1][F3][RD-2]. The meter excess line of $4.51 is therefore not refunded as booked; only the segment's mileage is [F4][F6][RD-2]. Safety screen: I read every chat message [F7][F8], the driver's statement [F10] and the complaint — nothing threatening, intimidating, harassing, sexual or dangerous-driving related appears; this is a fare/route dispute [SAFE-1][SAFE-2].
